spans.s: मर m. dying, death.

मार a. killing, destroying (—˚). m. death, pestilence,
slaughter, murder, hindrance, obstruction, the god of love, the
Destroyer or Devil (with Buddhists). f. ई killing, pestilence.
मरक m. epidemic, plague.
मरकत n. emerald.
मारकत f. ई smaragdine.
मरकतमय (f. ई) made of emerald.

मरण n. = मर;
 ˚णं कृ to die.
मरणदशा f. the hour of death.
मरणभीरुक a. fearing death.*
मरणान्त a. ending in death.
मरणा˚न्तिक a. ending in death.
मरा॑यु a. mortal.

मराल m. a kind of swimming bird;
 *an elephant.*

मरिच m. the pepper shrub;
 n. grain of pepper.

मरीच m. & n. = prec.;
 m. also = म॑रीचि m.

मारीच a. relating to Marīci;
 m. = seq.
मरीचचूर्ण s. ground pepper.*

म॑रीचि f. mote in the air, beam of light (also मरीची);
m. N. of a Prajāpati, the father of Kacyapa.
मारीचि m. patron. from मरीचि.

मरीचिका^1 f. mirage.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: The anusvAra may be a print smudge..
मरीचिन् m. the sun (lit. = seq. a.).

मरीचिमन्त् a. having rays;
 m. the sun.

मरीचिमालिन् a. wreathed with rays;
 m. = prec. m.
मरीमृश॑ a. touching, groping.

मरु॑ m. waste, desert (often pl.);
 mountain.
मरु॑त् m. wind, god of the wind (only pl.), breath, air.
मरु॑त्त m. N. of sev. princes.

मा॑रुत relating to the Maruts or the wind. — m. wind,
air, the god of wind (adj. —˚ f. आ), E. of Viṣṇu & Rudra;
 f. आ N.
of a woman, f. ई (sc. दिश्) the north-west.

मारुत॑, f. relating to the Maruts or the wind. — m.
wind, air, the god of wind (adj. —˚ f. आ), E. of Viṣṇu & Rudra;
 f.
आ N. of a woman, f. ई (sc. दिश्) the north-west.
मरु॑त्तम (superl.) quite like the Maruts.
मरुत्पति m. lord of the Maruts (Indra).
मरु॑त्वन्त् a. having the Maruts (Indra).

मरुत्सख a. having the wind for a friend (clouds or
fire).
मरु॑त्सखि a. having the Maruts for friends.
मरुत्सहाय a. = मरुत्सख (fire).
1 मरुद्गण m. the host of the Maruts.
2 मरु॑द्गण a. belonging to the host of the Maruts.
मरु॑द्वृध a. rejoicing in the Maruts.
मरुधन्वन् m. desert land, wilderness.
मरुस्थल n. ˚ली f. the same.
1 म॑र्क m. eclipse (of the sun).
2 म॑र्क m. N. of the Purohita of the Asuras etc.
मर्क॑ट m. ई f. ape, monkey.
मार्कट f. ई apish, monkey-like.
मर्डितृ॑ m. pitier.
म॑र्त m. a mortal, man.
मर्तव्य n. impers. it must be died.
म॑र्त्य a. mortal, m. man.
मर्त्यता f. ˚त्व n. mortality, human condition.
मर्त्यत्रा॑ adv. among men.

मर्त्यभुवन n. ˚लोक m. the world of mortals,
the earth.
म॑र्त्येषित a. sent by mortals.

मर्द a. (—˚) = seq. a,;
 m. violent pressure, hard rubbing.

मर्दन f. ई crushing, grinding, rubbing, pressing,
afflicting, destroying (gen or —˚);
 n. the action of crushing etc.,
also anointing with (˚—).
मर्दनीय a. to be crushed or trodden down.
मर्दल m. a kind of drum.
मर्दि॑तव्य a. = मर्दनीय.
मर्दिन् a. (—˚) = मर्दन a.

मर्मग a. going to (cutting through) the vitals, very
painful.

मर्म˚च्छिद् a. going to (cutting through) the vitals,
very painful.

मर्म˚च्छेदिन् a. going to (cutting through) the
vitals, very painful.
मर्मच्छेद m. abstr. to मर्मच्छिद् (v. prec.).
म॑र्मन् n. open part of the body, vulnerable or weak spot.
मर्मभेदिन् a. = मर्मच्छिद् m. arrow.

मर्ममय a. consisting of or relating to the mortal
parts of man.
मर्मर a. & m. rustling, murmuring.
मर्मविद् a. = मर्मज्ञ.
मर्म˚वेदिन् a. = मर्मज्ञ.

मर्मस्पृश् (f. ˚घ्नी) touching or striking the
vitals, very painful or injurious (lit. & fig.).

मर्महन् (f. ˚घ्नी) touching or striking the vitals,
very painful or injurious (lit. & fig.).
मर्यक॑ m. little man.
मर्यत॑स् adv. from or amongst young men.
मर्यादाभेदक m. destroyer of landmarks.
मर्श m. a cert. sternutatory.
*मर्ष m. patient, endurance.
मर्शन n. touching, inquiring, examining.

मर्षण a. bearing, forgiving (—˚);
 n. = prec.
मर्षणीय a. to be borne or forgiven.
मर्षिन् a. patient, forbearing.
मारमोहित a. infatuated by the god of love.
माररिपु m. the foe of the god of love, i.e. Śiva.*
मारव f. ई forming or belonging to a desert.
मारात्मक a. murderous.
मारारि m. = माररिपु.
मारिन् a. dying or killing (—˚).

मारिष m. honourable man (often in voc. as a respectful
address).
मारी˚च्य m. patron. from मरीचि.
मारीय a. belonging to the god of love.
मा॑रुक a. perishing.

मारुती relating to the Maruts or the wind. — m. wind, air, the god
of wind (adj. —˚ f. आ), E. of Viṣṇu & Rudra;
 f. आ N. of a woman,
f. ई (sc. दिश्) the north-west.
मारुति m. the same.

मारुतसूनु m. the son of the god of wind, E. of
Hanumant.
मारुतात्मज m. the same.
मारुतान्दोलित a. swung or tossed by the wind.*
मारुतोद्वेल्लित a. the same.*
मार्कण्डेय m. patron. of an ancient sage, pl. his race.

मार्कण्डेयपुराण^1 n. T. of a Purāṇa.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275.

मार्ग् मार्गति मार्ग˚ते (मार्गयति), pp. मार्गित
track,
[]
hunt, (cf. seq.), seek for, strive after, ask, request (2
acc.) परि = S.
मार्गदर्शक m. guide (way-shower).
मार्गव m. N. of a mixed caste.
मार्गशीर्ष m. N. of a month.
मार्गस्थ a. being on the (right) way (l.&f.).
मार्गागत a. coming from a journey, m. a traveller.
मार्गायात a. coming from a journey, m. a traveller.

मार्गावलोकिन् a. waiting, impatient (lit. looking out
at a person's way).
मार्गितव्य a. to be searched for or striven after.
मार्जार (f. ई) & ˚क m. cat, esp. wild cat.
मार्जारलिङ्गिन् a. having the nature of a cat.
मार्जाल्य॑ a. = prec. a.
मार्डीक॑ n. mercy, grace.
मार्तण्ड m. the sun or the god of the s. (cf. seq.).
मार्ताण्ड॑ m. bird, esp. the bird in the sky i.e. the sun.
मार्त्तिक f. ई made of clay, earthen.
मा॑र्त्स्न a. ground fine or small.
मार्दव n. softness, meekness, kindness.
मार्ष्टि f. *washing, cleaning.
